title: Go: Constants & Iota
description: Write a Go program that declares constants using const and iota for enumerated values.

codeTemplate.go:
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	const pi = 3.14159
	const greeting = "Hello, Go!"

	const (
		Sunday = iota
		Monday
		Tuesday
		Wednesday
		Thursday
		Friday
		Saturday
	)

	fmt.Println("Pi:", pi)
	fmt.Println(greeting)
	fmt.Println("Monday:", Monday)
	fmt.Println("Friday:", Friday)
}

hints: `iota` increments automatically within a const block
`iota` starts at 0 for the first const in the block
